title: Russia’s ‘Miracle’ #cancer Vaccine : Medical Breakthrough or Political Hype? കാൻസർ വാക്സിൻ സത്യം?
description:
Russia has unveiled what it claims to be a groundbreaking mRNA cancer vaccine, named EnteroMix, with reports of up to 100% efficacy in clinical trials. Some are calling it a medical revolution — but is it really the miracle it sounds like?

In this video, we explore:

What the EnteroMix vaccine is and how it works

How mRNA is used to target cancer cells

Why some experts are skeptical

What this could mean for global cancer treatment

💉 Could this be a true breakthrough — or is the science being rushed for headlines?

👀 Watch till the end for expert opinions and a breakdown of the facts vs. hype.
🗣️ What do you think? Is this the future of cancer treatment — or too good to be true? Drop your thoughts in the comments!

#CancerVaccine #RussiaNews #EnteroMix #MedicalBreakthrough #mRNAVaccine #HealthNews #ScienceOrHype #കാൻസർ #വാക്സിൻ #പ്രതിരോധം #malayalam #vijayakumarblathur
കടപ്പാട്: Dr. Manoj Vellanad , Neurosurgeon Thiruvananthapuram

transcript: A new revolutionary discovery has been made in Russia. For the past few days, we have been seeing news that a vaccine against cancer has been found and we no longer have anything to fear. How much joy and happiness there is in that, how much this discovery will help in cancer treatment, and so on, are the topics we intend to discuss in today's video. Cancer is not a disease. It is a disordered, uncontrolled cell division and growth that occurs somewhere in our body. In general, cancer means that there may be many reasons for it. Therefore, finding a medicine that can prevent all types of cancer is not that easy . It is known that there are about 250 types of cancer that can occur in the human body . The cause and nature of each is different, so the treatment is also different. Surgery, chemotherapy, radiation, targeted medicine, and so on. Various types of treatments are now used against cancers. What we generally call vaccines are injections or drugs that are given in advance to prevent certain infectious diseases. A vaccine usually contains an agent that is similar to a pathogenic microorganism. This is often a form that has killed or weakened the microorganism or pathogen itself, or has modified or neutralized it in such a way that it is unable to spread the disease. Sometimes it is its toxin, sometimes it is its outer proteins. So when a person who does not have the disease is given the vaccine, that substance in the vaccine stimulates our immune system, makes it understand it, and makes it produce antibodies against it. What enters is not a pathogen that is capable of causing the disease, but an agent that has all the characteristics of the pathogen. Then our body can produce antibodies against it. Then later, the correct amount of the vaccine is injected into our body. A common method of vaccination is to train and prepare our bodies so that if a disease enters, it will produce antibodies against it, fight it, and destroy it, so that we will not get sick. Russia is now claiming to have developed a vaccine against cancer that has been tested in preclinical tests and studies and is giving good results . They called it Entromix. The results of their intensive research over the past three years have now been released, as a continuation of the research they have been conducting for the past several years. This is an mRNA vaccine. When we say mRNA, it means messenger ribonucleic acid. Yes, messenger means messengers. RNA means ribonucleic acid. As you know, ribonucleic acid is the basic genetic component of our living cells. Genetic codes from DNA are transferred to ribosomes like a message in mRNA. Therefore, this Entromix mRNA vaccine is a personalized vaccine. It is not a generic vaccine like the HPV vaccine against cervical cancer. That is, this vaccine does not matter to everyone. In addition, this vaccine will contain four non- pathogenic viruses that do not cause disease. These will directly attack and destroy cancer cells without harming other cells. This is similar to the technology used in Covid-19 vaccines like Sputnik. It is made based on the tumor genomics gene profile of each patient. If a person has cancer, his cancer cells will produce a specific type of protein called tumor antigen. That is to say, if we can make antibodies against it in our body, cancer cells will not be able to multiply. Through mRNA technology, the cells in the body are trained to make tumor antigens, which are special proteins that only cancer cells produce. The body's immune system recognizes these proteins, produces antibodies, and destroys cancer cells. This is done based on the tumor genomics gene profile of each patient . Russia claims that with the help of new artificial intelligence technology, it is now possible to map the genetic makeup of each patient and produce a protein that is unique to him very quickly and in a short time with the help of neural network computing. That is the current discovery. This may be helpful in the future to treat patients with various types of cancer. Whether it will provide practical help in preventing cancer in a person without the disease in the future will only be proven through new studies. As we think when we hear the word "general vaccine", this vaccine cannot prevent all of us from getting cancer in advance, which means there is no need to have excessive expectations. Veronika Skorzova, head of the Federal Medical and Biological Agency of Russia, claims that the preclinical phase and animal testing phase have been completed, in which the tumor size has shrunk by 60 to 80 percent and the tumor growth has slowed down. In the first phase of clinical trials involving 48 volunteers, it is said that 100 percent efficacy and safety were shown in phase one of the patients. The tumor shrank and no serious side effects were reported, confirming that the vaccine is safe even after repeated administration. In addition to claiming that it will be very effective against colorectal cancer, a type of colon cancer that is very common in the world, they also say that they are starting studies to see if it will be effective against glioblastoma, a type of brain cancer, and melanoma, a type of skin cancer that affects the eyes. While this is good to hear, there is little to celebrate, but large-scale trials are still needed to confirm whether these are as effective as they claim. The results of animal experiments are difficult to directly apply to humans. The integrity of the data and peer reviews are lacking. Russian regulations are different from those of other countries, so more evidence is needed to accept this type of treatment on a global scale. There is no information about these studies in scientific journals or portals other than the news that comes in the media. This news was widely reported in the world media a year ago. It was given. Then, the production of this personalized vaccine, cold design, storage, genomics profiling, etc. pose great challenges. Some are very different. Immunotherapy, a treatment for cancer that stimulates the immune system and cures the disease, already exists. James P. Alison, Tasuku Hojo, and others were awarded the 2018 Nobel Prize for their discoveries about a kind of brake system in immune cells. Katalin Kariko and Drew Weisman also received the 2023 Nobel Prize for discovering how mRNA works in the immune system. It was their vision that gave us the way to produce a Covid vaccine in 2020. In any case, the fact that these types of vaccines do not kill normal cells other than cancer cells, as chemotherapy does, and that they do not have the side effects of chemotherapy, gives great hope. New discoveries, studies and experiments in modern medicine will help save the lives of millions of people, increase their lifespan and improve their quality. We can see this breakthrough by Rishi as a good sign that a time will come when cancer, which is a very minor disease that can be prevented and treated, will be a time when cancer, which is a major threat to our lives, will be prevented and treated.
